dialogue.speaker: Agus
dialogue.text: Hai, kamu punya waktu sebentar? Kamu tampak cemas.
dialogue.en: Hi, do you have a minute? You look worried.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya. Aku ingin meminta cuti satu hari pada hari Jumat depan.
dialogue.en: Yes. I would like to ask for a day off next Friday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sedikit. Aku harus pergi ke pernikahan sepupuku di kota lain.
dialogue.en: A little. I must go to my cousin's wedding in another city.

dialogue.speaker: Agus
dialogue.text: Aku mengerti. Siapa yang bisa menangani pekerjaanmu hari itu?
dialogue.en: I see. Who can cover your work that day?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Rekanku bisa menggantikanku, dan aku akan menyiapkan semuanya sebelumnya.
dialogue.en: My colleague can replace me, and I will prepare everything in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Agus
dialogue.text: Itu membantu. Apakah kamu sudah memintanya?
dialogue.en: That is helpful. Have you asked her already?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Belum. Aku ingin bicara denganmu dulu, sebagai bantuan.
dialogue.en: Not yet. I wanted to speak with you first, as a favor.

dialogue.speaker: Agus
dialogue.text: Aku paham. Kamu boleh mengambil hari itu, tetapi selesaikan laporannya sebelum pergi.
dialogue.en: I understand. You may take the day, but finish the report before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Of course, thank you for being so understanding.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Terima kasih banyak. Aku akan membawakanmu sepotong kue.
dialogue.en: Thank you very much. I will bring you some cake.
